STEP 6. Check the harness wire between fusible link 
number 2 and stoplight switch connector C-03.
NOTE:  After inspecting the intermediate connector C-89, C-
107, or C-110, inspect the wire. If the intermediate connector C-
89, C-107, or C-110 is damaged, repair or replace it. Refer to 
GROUP 00E, Harness Connector Inspection P.00E-2. If the 
connector has been repaired or replaced, go to Step 7.
Q: Is the harness wire between the fusible link number 2 
and the stoplight switch connector C-03 damaged?
YES : Repair it and then go to Step 7.
NO : Check and repair the harness wire between stoplight 
switch and stoplight. Then go to Step 7.
